items.summary: CTO review: authorize only bounded read-only inspection of existing failure artifacts, continuation of deployed-work measurement, private-gate evidence work, and repair or closure of existing failed requests. Do not create new proposals, telemetry requests, production changes, spend, or queue entries. Requeue only an existing approved request after confirming isolated worktree cleanup, root cause, smallest reversible repair, focused validation, rollback steps, and owner-role routing. Preserve unknown attribution, causality, ROI, and unavailable cost fields.

Queue disposition: existing approved work may enter the queue only after its retained failure is repaired or explicitly closed and validation evidence is complete. No new discretionary growth, production expansion, or financial work is queue-eligible this cycle.

Measurement disposition: continue existing gates using only period-aligned impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and directly evidenced incremental costs. Do not infer revenue, ROI, contribution margin, causal lift, or cost allocation from aggregate or mismatched periods.
